description: Lists every universe you can use: your own ticker lists and the built-in ones. `kind: builtin` lists the built-in universes (top_10, top_100); omit it for yours; `builtin,custom` lists both. Use a slug as `universe` on scan, signal and subscribe tools.

cursor.description: The previous response's `next_cursor`. Send it with the same params as the first page (`limit` may change); a page whose params differ is a 400 naming the param.

kind.description: Which universes to list: `builtin` (`top_10`, `top_100`), `custom` (your own) or both as a comma list. Leave it out for your own; from the cut-off on Deprecations it lists both. Values: builtin, custom.

search.description: Only universes whose id, name or description contains this text (case-insensitive). Results are ranked across built-in and your own universes: an exact id or name match first, then an id or name that starts with the term, then one that contains it, then descriptions that have it as a whole word, then descriptions that contain it; list order within each rank. Paging a search never repeats or skips.

name: tickerbot_list_universes
